column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight 75 Mortgage Loan (4.4%), with respect to the Tractor Supply - Villa Rica, Georgia mortgaged property, having an allocated loan amount of $3,896,680 or 10.4% of the loan amount, the sole tenant (Tractor Supply) has a ROFR to purchase the related mortgaged property if the borrower receives an offer that it is otherwise willing to accept. The ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.
